title: Focused launcher preset ignores the caller's directory; UI-only focused Vitest runs need the root-relative --root ui form; document it in docs/test.md
outcome: An agent running a focused UI check through the launcher knows which form works: docs/test.md says that the focused preset runs its command from the repository root, whatever directory the caller is in, and gives the working form for a UI-only Vitest run.
acceptance: docs/test.md states that `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- COMMAND ...` runs COMMAND from the repository root regardless of the caller's working directory (the focused stage sets no cwd, scripts/test-launcher.mjs around :1587; stageDirectory defaults to the root).

docs/test.md gives the working form for a UI-only focused Vitest run, `node ui/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root ui <file>`, and says that `npx` is not resolvable by the launcher on Windows and that a fresh worktree needs `npm ci` in ui/ first.
